own_solution.law: v_rod = sqrt(E/rho); free-free fundamental f = v_rod/(2L); dust spacing = v_air/(2f) = L v_air/v_rod
assumptions: fundamental mode with node at central clamp
heaps at displacement nodes half a wavelength apart

T94AF.regime: thin-rod regime: diameter much smaller than the rod length and wavelength (authors' predicate 10*d < L)

T9574.regime: thin-rod regime: diameter much smaller than the rod length and wavelength (authors' predicate 10*d < L)

defect_reasons.other: TFBD6/T2604 attach the timing clause 'Before the clamp is fitted' to the bar on the rack, which has no clamp; the wording is slightly odd though the rod/bar distinction is clear.

notes: Recomputed: v_rod = 5091.75 m/s; base spacing 1.2*343/5091.75 = 8.0837 cm; R answers 1.34 -> 9.0268, 1.52 -> 10.2393, 1.75 -> 11.7887 cm; all match. In pass 1 I labelled the diameter sentences C (area cancels); the authors label them K with a thin-rod regime. Both are defensible: in elementary theory the area cancels, and the diameter matters only through the Rayleigh lateral-inertia correction outside the thin-rod regime; the listed 6.5-13 mm are deep inside it (correction ~ (nu pi r/lambda)^2 ~ 1e-5). The 10*d < L predicate is crude but correctly classifies the listed values. Minimal pairs T2604/TD83B (bar vs rod) and TA297/T3295 (earlier run vs before clamping) keep 32 cm and differ only in attachment; diameter and area variants each keep their own number. Numeral-free twins TFBD6, TFE55 by design.
